name: Currency Option
definition: Right to buy (call) or sell (put) an underlying amount in one currency against another amount in another currency at a predetermined exchange rate, within a specified period of time or at a specified date and time.

CallAmount.name: Call Amount
CallAmount.definition: Call amount and currency of a foreign exchange option trade.

PutAmount.name: Put Amount
PutAmount.definition: Put amount and currency of a foreign exchange option trade.

OptionSettlementCurrency.name: Option Settlement Currency
OptionSettlementCurrency.definition: Currency that must be used to settle the option when it is netted off.

StrikeRate.name: Strike Rate
StrikeRate.definition: Fixed exchange rate at which the option contract can be exercised.

PremiumCalculation.name: Premium Calculation
PremiumCalculation.definition: Specifies the way the premium is calculated.

OptionDefinition.name: Option Definition
OptionDefinition.definition: Specifies the different parameters used to define an option.

PremiumSettlement.name: Premium Settlement
PremiumSettlement.definition: Specifies the amount of the premium paid by the buyer of the option and its settlement place.

ExercisedOption.name: Exercised Option
ExercisedOption.definition: Specifies the trade that may take place to exercise the option.
